title: Hearts to Health Bar !
description: This texture pack replaces the hearts, air, and hunger bars with stylish and detailed progress bars!
body:
# Health Bar

A stylish and clean resource pack that transforms the vanilla Minecraft HUD into a smooth progress-bar interface. 

The design features custom containers inspired by the polished deepslate texture, making the interface look integrated with the game's natural aesthetic.

### ✨ Features:
* Progress Bars: Smooth and clean bars for your Health, Hunger, and Oxygen.
* Negative Effects: Fully customized looks for Poison, Wither, and Freezing states.
* Special Modes: Dedicated designs for Hardcore mode and Absorption (Golden Hearts) overlay.
* Vehicle Health: Mount health (horses, donkeys, etc.) is fully supported and adapted to match the new progress-bar style.
* Armor Icons: Refined and clean armor icons that match the theme without cluttering the screen.

### 🚀 Compatibility:
* Works with Vanilla Minecraft.
* No OptiFine or UI mods required.
